digest.component_or_area: rebar plan vocabulary and criteria registry
propositions: Two separate headings—Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria—carry identical semantics and routing rules across criteria gates, introducing vestigial vocabulary split and implementation inconsistencies.

Success Criteria bullets are not counted by _count_ac_items, cannot carry [operator-attested] tags, and are not individually checkable, whereas Acceptance Criteria checkboxes are; collapsing the heading tightens the gate.

106 store tickets carry legacy ## Success Criteria headings that must be migrated to ## Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, and detectors/prompts/routes/guides must be updated to accept only the unified vocabulary.
Acceptance Criteria checkbox requirements must be enforced consistently across all criterion types (F1, G3, G7, completion verifier) with no separate bar for Success Criteria.

Three live files—plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, and verify_models.py—legitimately retain the dod_uncertifiable and trial-metrics language and must be excluded from the vocabulary collapse.
